name: OmaVault
author: anel
description: Back up your Omarchy settings, Hyprland config, terminal configs and installed plugins as an AES-256 encrypted, checksummed folder tree you can carry on a USB stick and restore on a fresh machine. A password is required every time -- there is no plain-text option.

barWidget.description: Export/import your Omarchy setup to/from a USB stick, encrypted with a required password.
